page_title: REI 2-4 NIC | Reims v Nice 11/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Junya Ito (Reims) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+5' Reims can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+3' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Nice players look gutted.
90+2' The Nice players halt their celebrations as referee Willy Delajod makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

90+1' Goal! Youssoufa Moukoko displays great vision and sends a pass to Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. The score is 2:5.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Sofiane Diop (Nice) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
88' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Gaetan Laborde will be replaced by Youssoufa Moukoko (Nice).
86' 2 - 4 Fantastic team goal! Ali Abdi (Nice) was set free in the area by Mohamed-Ali Cho and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the top of the net. 2:4.
85' The number of shots on goal at present is 3:9.
82' It will be a substitution. Mohamed Aboubakar Bamba (Reims) is ready to enter the pitch as Teddy Teuma walks off.
82' Here is a change. Buta is going off and Luka Elsner gives the last tactical orders to Abdoul Kone (Reims).
81' Teddy Teuma (Reims) sends the corner into the box, but Marcin Bulka intercepts it and averts the threat.
80' Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tanguy Ndombele trots off the pitch and is replaced by Tom Louchet (Nice).
77' Luka Elsner has decided to substitute Joseph Okumu and he is replaced by Thibault De Smet (Reims).
76' Buta (Reims) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
74' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Oumar Diakite (Reims) was quite harsh and Willy Delajod didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
73' Substitution. Badredine Bouanani will be replaced by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice).
73' Franck Haise prepares a substitution. Evann Guessand is replaced by Ali Abdi (Nice).

71' 2 - 3 Nice piece of skill by Mamadou Diakhon (Reims). He perfectly collected a pass from Marshall Munetsi and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went inside the right post. The score is 2:3.
71' Luka Elsner has decided to make a change. Nhoa Sangui (Reims) replaces Valentin Atangana Edoa.
71' Substitution. Keito Nakamura leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mamadou Diakhon (Reims).

69' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf pulls off an easy save.
68' A pass from Evann Guessand (Nice) is intercepted by Yehvann Diouf and the move breaks down.
68' Sofiane Diop (Nice) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
68' Sofiane Diop (Nice) is caught offside!
65' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) receives a yellow card for infringement.
64' 1 - 3 Sofiane Diop provides Gaetan Laborde (Nice) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
63' The resulting corner from Junya Ito (Reims) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
63' Oumar Diakite (Reims) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Reims.
59' Oumar Diakite (Reims) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
58' Teddy Teuma (Reims) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
57' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Sergio Akieme (Reims).
56' Luka Elsner appears to have said too much and referee Willy Delajod comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
55' Junya Ito (Reims) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

54' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
53' One of the Reims players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
53' Melvin Bard (Nice) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
52' Oumar Diakite (Reims) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
51' Teddy Teuma (Reims) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
48' Sergio Akieme (Reims) has tested the patience of referee Willy Delajod and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
46' The game is over for Jonathan Clauss (Nice). Antoine Mendy comes on for the second half.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+7' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Teddy Teuma (Reims) took the corner.
45+6' An attempted cross from Junya Ito (Reims) is cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Reims.
45+5' Sergio Akieme (Reims) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
45+4' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Nice was in an offside position.
45+1' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45+1' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 2 Goal! Gaetan Laborde (Nice) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Yehvann Diouf into middle of the goal.
43' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
42' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
42' Cedric Kipre (Reims) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Willy Delajod blows for a foul. PENALTY to Nice! Great chance to score.
39' Great teamplay by Nice as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
37' Evann Guessand (Nice) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
34' 1 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Junya Ito (Reims) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 1:1.
34' Sofiane Diop (Nice) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Willy Delajod has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
31' Sofiane Diop (Nice) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but Yehvann Diouf is alert and denies him with a nice save.

28' 0 - 1 Goal! Jonathan Clauss sent in a fine cross from the corner kick. The perfect pass found Evann Guessand (Nice) and his bullet header from around the penalty spot went straight into the right side of the goal. The score is 0:1.
28' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) will deliver the corner kick.
28' Evann Guessand (Nice) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out for a corner. Nice can continue in their attacking effort.
27' Teddy Teuma (Reims) brings an opponent down and Willy Delajod interrupts the game.
26' Sofiane Diop (Nice) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yehvann Diouf intercepts the ball.

24' A huge opportunity wasted! Gaetan Laborde (Nice) produces a header from a rebound inside the six-yard box. His effort is denied by one of the defenders who is well positioned and clears the ball to safety.
24' Melvin Bard (Nice) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the left post is thwarted by Yehvann Diouf.

23' Sergio Akieme (Reims) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
22' Shots on target – 1:2.
19' The Nice players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
18' Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
17' Looks like Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

15' Junya Ito (Reims) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
14' Teddy Teuma (Reims) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
13' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
11' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
11' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner with a short pass.

10' Yehvann Diouf pulls off a great save to deny Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Nice force their opponents to concede a corner.
9' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
9' Nice failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
7' A player from Reims commits a rough challenge. Willy Delajod blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
4' The Nice players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Willy Delajod saw the whole situation.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Reims will take the kick-off.
Willy Delajod will supervise the game today.
